description: Cancel a pending scheduled message by its id. The queued text is gone for good, and a repeat stops, so the first call returns a preview and a confirm_token; repeating the call with the token cancels it.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

dry_run.description: If true, nothing is changed: the result shows what this call would do.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

schedule_id.description: The id schedule_message returned, also shown by list_scheduled_messages.

name: cancel_scheduled_message
title: Cancel scheduled message
